_comment: 由 sync_translation.py 维护，请勿手改。记录上次确认时每个已翻译键的英文原文。

line:menu_translation/kill-feed:interfac.$KF_BackgroundColor_Help: Background color. Accepts RGB (0,0,0) or hex (#000000)
line:menu_translation/kill-feed:interfac.$KF_BackgroundFade_Help: Apply a horizontal transparency gradient to the background
line:menu_translation/kill-feed:interfac.$KF_Debug_Help: Log all kills and their causes to po3_KillFeed.log
line:menu_translation/kill-feed:interfac.$KF_DefaultTextColor_Help: Set default text color. Accepts RGB (255,0,0) or hex (#FF0000)
line:menu_translation/kill-feed:interfac.$KF_FadeInTime_Help: How long (in seconds) it takes for the notification to fade in
line:menu_translation/kill-feed:interfac.$KF_FadeOutTime_Help: How long (in seconds) it takes for the notification to fade out
line:menu_translation/kill-feed:interfac.$KF_Height_Help: Height of the kill feed (in pixels)
line:menu_translation/kill-feed:interfac.$KF_IconTintOverride_Help: Whether to override icon tints via IconTintOverrides.json. If false, default icon tint will be applied to all icons
line:menu_translation/kill-feed:interfac.$KF_IconTint_Help: Set default icon tint. Any icon tints defined in IconTintOverrides.json will override this.\nAccepts RGB (255,0,0) or hex (#FF0000)
line:menu_translation/kill-feed:interfac.$KF_LifeTime_Help: How long (in seconds) the notification remains fully visible on screen
line:menu_translation/kill-feed:interfac.$KF_MaxDistance_Help: Skip kill notification if target distance is greater than this. Set to 0 for unlimited distance
line:menu_translation/kill-feed:interfac.$KF_NumEntries_Help: Maximum number of kill feed entries to display
line:menu_translation/kill-feed:interfac.$KF_PosX_Help: Horizontal position of the kill feed (in pixels)
line:menu_translation/kill-feed:interfac.$KF_PosY_Help: Vertical position of the kill feed (in pixels)
line:menu_translation/kill-feed:interfac.$KF_ShowBackground_Help: Draw a semi-transparent background behind each kill feed entry.
line:menu_translation/kill-feed:interfac.$KF_ShowDirection_Help: Display a compass arrow pointing toward the victim (if offscreen).
line:menu_translation/kill-feed:interfac.$KF_ShowDistance_Help: Display the distance from the player to the victim (if offscreen).
line:menu_translation/kill-feed:interfac.$KF_SingleIcon_Help: Show a single icon instead of separate source and element icons. Spells display an element icon, and enchanted weapons display a source icon tinted by enchantment type
line:menu_translation/kill-feed:interfac.$KF_SlideOffsetX_Help: Controls horizontal slide animation distance (Negative: Right->Left, Positive: Left->Right)
line:menu_translation/kill-feed:interfac.$KF_SlideOffsetY_Help: Controls vertical slide animation distance (Negative: Up->Down, Positive: Down->Up)
line:menu_translation/kill-feed:interfac.$KF_TextColor_Help: Set text color for actors belonging to this category. Accepts RGB (255,0,0) or hex (#FF0000)
line:menu_translation/kill-feed:interfac.$KF_VerticalSpacing_Help: Adjust spacing between kill feed entries
line:menu_translation/kill-feed:interfac.$KF_VisibilityKills_Help: Filter kill notifications from this source by line of sight. Select Disabled to hide all notifications for this category
line:menu_translation/kill-feed:interfac.$KF_VisibilityReanimation_Help: Filter reanimation notifications from this source by line of sight. Select Disabled to hide all notifications for this category
line:menu_translation/kill-feed:interfac.$KF_Width_Help: Width of the kill feed (in pixels)
